verdicts.reason: A: the white panel fills almost the whole strip, so the pop-art shapes shrink to slivers at the edges and the design loses its character. The FIZZBANG badge is jammed against the left canvas edge and straddles the panel border over a cropped navy shape. B: keeps more of the original's look (pink circle, navy quarter-circle, yellow stripe), but the shapes are crudely cropped at the top and bottom. The badge sits awkwardly across the yellow stripe and the panel edge, and the headline nearly touches the CTA pill. B is still the more recognisable and better-ordered banner.
